topic: How a nerve cell sends a signal

text: This is a nerve cell, also called a neuron, the wire of the nervous system.
Its branches on the left, the dendrites, collect messages from other cells.
The signal is an electrical pulse that leaves the cell body and runs down the axon.
The axon is wrapped in myelin, so the pulse jumps from gap to gap, which is much faster.
At the terminals, the pulse triggers chemicals that cross to the next cell and pass the message on.
